items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: I've heard plenty about them. ... That was his name. They called him Noonie. But Noonie Johnson was his name. That's him, him and Willie Jackson were the two entertainers back there.

ctx.x: Who was in Blind Freddy's band?

Me and Blind Freddy. Oh. I can't call all those men name at the time, right at the time they had to come to me, that's been a long time ago. Yeah. I can't call them all names, but I can't call all of them names because there was one, Brown, I remember Brown used to play slide. He played Key Slide. He's passed on. He lived upon, used to live upon Josephine, he used to play slide with us. He lived up where? Up on Josephine Street, him and Tick Chambers, you ever hear of Tick Chambers? Yeah. Yeah, well he was in the…
That was a man or a woman?
